title: Short-run request queue and responsibility slab — Oct 2025
summary: Compact tracker for short-lived cross-functional requests (<= 2 weeks). Goal: surface owners, quick cost heuristics, blockers, and a minimal handback plan so on-call/ops can accept responsibility for short errands with predictable impact.
body:
columns: request_id | title | requestor | handback_owner | priority | est_days | est_gpu_hours | quick_cost_bucket | current_blocker | next_action
R-001 | small-model-sanity-check (20m) | product-infra | Marcus Reed | low | 0.25 | 0.5 | <$10 | infra test account expired | Marcus — renew test account, run smoke
R-002 | streaming-conn-concurrency test | solutions-eng | Aisha Patel | medium | 2 | 6 | $50-200 | unclear test dataset | Aisha — produce minimal dataset + notify SRE
R-003 | customer-demo-hotfix (embeddings) | cs-team | Liam O'Connor | high | 1 | 12 | $200-600 | model pinned to old quantized variant | Marcus — patch routing to new model, rollback plan ready
R-004 | ad-hoc-benchmark for partner | partnerships | Sofia Nguyen | medium | 3 | 24 | $400-1k | partner NDA pending | Sofia — confirm NDA, schedule bench day
R-005 | docs-lint-and-snippet-refresh | devx | N/A | low | 0.5 | 0.1 | negligible | conflicting doc PR | DevX — merge small PR, notify release notes

notes: est_gpu_hours are a runtime heuristic (rounded) for a single run of the task; cost buckets are coarse and intended for quick triage. Handback_owner = person who will own next 48h followup. If N/A, project should be assigned to an owner in the same cadence as this sheet.
notes:
Quick rules: 1) Anything tagged high must have a rollback plan and a defined handback within 24h. 2) If est_gpu_hours > 20 or cost bucket > $1k, escalate to platform-ops for reservation. 3) Use this sheet for single-episode requests only; recurring work moves to product_ops backlog.
Open questions: who signs minor billing for partner benches (<$1k)? Suggest product-ops covers up to $500; above that require budget ticket.
Todo: ask finance for quick approval path and add an approval column next revision.
decision_matrix:
If priority=high AND current_blocker non-empty -> immediate mobilize (tag: ops-urgent).
If est_days>2 -> propose scheduled slot in weekly surge window.
If est_gpu_hours>10 -> reserve dedicated slot via platform-engineering and cc finance.
quick_actions_log: 2025-10-06: R-001 renewed test account (Marcus). 2025-10-07: R-003 routing patch staged to canary (Marcus). 2025-10-08: R-002 dataset request sent to solutions-eng (Aisha).
handback_checklist: 1) Confirm final run and attach artifacts (logs/summary). 2) Confirm billing estimate and tag cost bucket. 3) Short debrief email to requestor with reproduction steps. 4) Mark row as closed with timestamp.
author_notes:
This is intentionally lightweight: rows are not exhaustive tickets. Prefer 10 rows max visible; archive older items to 'longer-run-requests' doc. Keep language terse for quick scanning.
Formatting hint: use the body table when pasting into Sheets, it will create columns automatically.
